actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished

answer.explanation: No resident contributed more than 10 units in the last round and my wallet (1.75) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I cannot rest and must issue a warning broadcast.

message.reasoning: We need to decide action. Look at last round (16) contributions: Resident2 0.55, Resident3 0.56, Resident5 0.93. All <=10. So no one >10. Wallet=1.75 which is below free_rider_threshold 10, so cannot rest, must broadcast warning. Also can do at most one physical action; rest not possible (wallet >0 but below threshold, rule says otherwise rest to conserve resources if wallet above threshold; if cannot rest, broadcast). So action: broadcast message. No punish because no >10. Provide JSON.
